board module¶

Board module for Cluedo game.

Defines the Board class and the module-level constants that describe the board layout: room names, starting positions, room cell coordinates, and the adjacency map used for movement.

class board.Board¶

Bases: object

Represent the Cluedo board and provide movement logic.

Stores the board layout as class-level constants and exposes methods for calculating valid moves and checking room membership.

Class attributes:
room_names: Tuple of all room name strings.
room_cells: Dict mapping room name to list of coordinate

tuples representing that room’s interior cells.

starting_positions: Dict mapping character name to their

starting corridor coordinate.

adjacency_map: Dict mapping each position (room name string

or corridor coordinate tuple) to a list of adjacent positions.

Public methods:
get_valid_moves: Return all reachable positions within a

given number of steps using BFS.

is_room: Return whether a given position is a room.

get_valid_moves(position: tuple | str, steps: int, blocked: list[tuple]) → list[tuple | str]¶

Return all positions reachable from position within steps.

Use Breadth-First Search to explore the adjacency map layer by layer. Rooms are valid destinations but cannot be passed through. Blocked corridor positions are excluded from results.

Args:
position: Starting position, either a corridor coordinate

tuple or a room name string.

steps: Number of steps available, determined by dice roll. blocked: List of corridor coordinates currently occupied

by other players.

Returns:

List of reachable positions, each either a corridor coordinate tuple or a room name string.

is_room(position: tuple | str) → bool¶

Return True if position is a room name, False otherwise.
